continuous_host_monitor.policy: Reject unrelated compilers, outside same-user CPU above 5%, or outside CPU excluding the recorded Falcon service above 5% for three consecutive two-second intervals. Record Falcon overhead and include it in timings.

storage.filesystem_scope: All Linux timing arms use the same scratch filesystem.

current_replay_recovery.reason: Two incomplete cells were retried: Codex stock after a deterministic temporary-filename assertion, then uv Ohm after compiler-overlap detection during warmup. Completed samples and their original logs were preserved.

system_cpu.scope: Timed commands only. Windows are estimates from original log final-write mtime minus measured duration, not exact process start/stop timestamps. The union of intersecting two-second telemetry intervals is computed without double counting; every uncovered gap is reported. Separate monotonic interval and wall-clock timestamp reads, log-write latency, short-lived process exits, and telemetry resolution limit attribution. Same-UID means process ownership. CPU statistics do not change acceptance or select samples by performance.

summary: Two compiler-overlap incidents caused three direct workflow samples to be discarded. Both affected workflows restarted from fresh artifacts; all 216 accepted samples passed.

A Codex TUI test rejected the Base64 representation of a temporary file path as inline image data. Running the same test binary with only a different real temporary-directory path isolated the assertion. All four Codex replay cells use that corrected path. The failed cell restarted from fresh artifacts, with the first four completed sessions and their logs preserved unchanged.

A later compiler-overlap detection stopped the second uv/Ohm session during warmup, before any timed command. Eight completed sessions and their logs were preserved; the unfinished uv session restarted with fresh private and shared build directories. Both interrupted attempts and their artifacts remain preserved.

Two toolchain provisioning attempts failed before any benchmark measurement: an isolated rustup installation check and a public mirror timeout. Provisioning completed with the verified official release assets and unchanged toolchain versions.

A storage-retirement check stopped before any deletion or replay timing because it could not inspect a process file-descriptor directory. The process was verified as a single-thread zombie, the guard was corrected, and the failed check and identity evidence were retained.
